designer-initial.summary: Selected a hard-tier threat-evidence and protective-departure coordinator with 15 usages, 32 interactions, 29 cases, 12 scenarios, and independent defense/escape recovery.
questions_for_model: Can the trusted source subset realize defense and escape as independent actual-next-state and gate owners, including a blocked recovery-confirmation evaluation, without central recomputation or analyzer-only semantics?

Can one complete response frame be fanned out identically to pilot, defense, and navigation contexts as exactly three semantic interactions without partial public outputs or a routing-only semantic usage?

Can the retained analyzer exhaust 1,492,992 valuations under the watchdog while checking owner-local results, cross-channel noninterference, fresh-event recovery, all 29 cases, and all 12 scenario families; if not, what semantics-preserving deterministic factorization is needed?
Does the trusted GUMBO/SysML-AADL subset support actual-next-state downstream use in the same logical evaluation while keeping both channel transition contracts local to their owners?

diversity.selected_primary_scope: Threat evidence qualification, retained reporting, defense activation, and retreat-oriented departure coordination; mining is only an external equipment-safe interlock and cargo/service are excluded.
diversity.closest_baseline: Accepted replicate-1 Hard system: Mining-frigate threat, retreat, and service supervision.
diversity.why_not_extension_or_rename: The selected system does not choose among mining, defense, retreat, hold, and service or publish a mission phase/action. It emits orthogonal defense and departure directives from parallel channel-local recovery/readiness/proposal branches, keeps departure primary while defense may remain concurrent, and recovers failed channels independently while the other remains usable.

model-review.summary: Align PART-15 with its declared inputs and credit only its nonidentity response-stage derivation; retain all selected counts and domain behavior.

findings.evidence: PASS-06 requires PART-15 to use PART-06 ThreatValidity, but INT-24 through INT-29 give PART-15 only pattern, proposals, PART-07 alert/report, and both channel states. Adding validity changes the exact 32-interaction inventory; reaching back to qualification violates LOCAL-04.
findings.requested_change: Replace the PART-06-validity dependency in PASS-06 with PART-07's already-derived ThreatReport carried with actual next alert on INT-27. Keep PART-01 through PART-15, INT-01 through INT-32, all metrics, cases, scenarios, and claim-boundary exclusions unchanged; preserve the exact invalid-evidence frame through FAULT-03, VER-FAULT-03, and PASS-04.

findings.evidence: PART-15 has one substantive four-way ResponseStage classification, but its planned report, pattern, and channel-state fields are copies, its proposal-to-directive relations are one-to-one enum-label mappings, and frame construction/fan-out is bundling/routing. Those relations cannot support owner-local-fact or semantic-usage credit under M-17, although PART-15 remains meaningful because CASE-26 through CASE-29 classify stage.
findings.requested_change: Narrow PART-15, OWN-01, DEC-OBL-01, DEC-OBL-05, and later metrics ownership evidence so PART-15 is credited only for ResponseStage derivation under CASE-26 through CASE-29. Retain report/directive/pattern/state preservation, frame construction, and INT-30 through INT-32 as required but uncredited coherence obligations. Clarify CASE-26 accordingly; change no selected PART, INT, count, scenario, output, state transition, priority, recovery behavior, or claim boundary.

findings.evidence: Extensionally, PART-06 performs many-to-one validity classification; PART-07 through PART-09 own state-dependent transitions; PART-10 and PART-11 combine multiple conditions into readiness; PART-12 and PART-13 combine alert, readiness, and fresh authority into proposals; and PART-14 maps four proposal pairs to three prioritized patterns. None relies on copying, bundling, routing, or a bijective code rename for owner credit.

Library commit 9016cbcceefa92f0068e1811923704dd261d15f1 and Sireum v4.20260630.386eac9f support the selected System/Process/Thread containment, typed record ports, local GUMBO state and actual-next outputs, compute cases, and direct typed fan-out. Current checker runs returned Well-formed for accepted models exercising local next-state composition and one producer output connected to multiple consumers.

The exact bounded product is 1,492,992 valuations under a 180-second harness watchdog. On the current host, retained analyzers covering 980,424 snapshots and a factorized 47,185,920-valuation product each completed in about 1.5 seconds, so exhaustive owner-local and end-to-end checking is feasible without changing semantics or the bounded-evidence claim boundary.
